s1.syndrome_frame: A middle-aged woman with a long-standing breast lump and migratory discomfort in the right axilla and upper-outer quadrant
salient_findings: Mobile lump in the right breast
Migratory discomfort and pain in the right axilla and upper-outer quadrant
Hypoechoic and low-echo masses on breast ultrasonography
key_facts: No family history of breast cancer
Breast ultrasonography revealed hypoechoic and low-echo masses
No obvious blood-flow signals detected within the lesions on color Doppler flow imaging

raw.syndrome_frame: A middle-aged woman with a long-standing breast lump and migratory discomfort in the right axilla and upper-outer quadrant
salient_findings: Mobile lump in the right breast
Migratory discomfort and pain in the right axilla and upper-outer quadrant
Hypoechoic and low-echo masses on breast ultrasonography
key_facts: No family history of breast cancer
Breast ultrasonography revealed hypoechoic and low-echo masses
No obvious blood-flow signals detected within the lesions on color Doppler flow imaging

shortlist.label: Invasive ductal carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Hypoechoic and low-echo masses on ultrasonography, BIRADS 4b and 4a lesions

shortlist.label: Fibroadenoma
shortlist.why_kept: Mobile lump palpated on examination, hypoechoic and tubular structure on ultrasonography

shortlist.label: Phyllodes tumor
shortlist.why_kept: Mobile lump and hypoechoic masses on ultrasonography, variable echogenicity

shortlist.label: Papillary carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Low-echo mass with well-delineated contours on ultrasonography, BIRADS 4a lesion

shortlist.label: Tubular carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Hypoechoic and tubular structure on ultrasonography, BIRADS 4b lesion

shortlist.label: Fat necrosis
shortlist.why_kept: History of trauma or impure water consumption, migratory discomfort and pain in the right axilla

shortlist.label: Granulomatous mastitis
shortlist.why_kept: Migratory discomfort and pain in the right axilla, hypoechoic masses on ultrasonography

shortlist.label: Sclerosing adenosis
shortlist.why_kept: Hypoechoic masses on ultrasonography, surrounding increased echogenicity

raw.rationale: The presence of a mobile lump, hypoechoic and low-echo masses with well-delineated contours on ultrasonography, and the absence of obvious blood-flow signals within the lesions are consistent with fibroadenoma, a common benign breast tumor.

rejected.label: Invasive ductal carcinoma
rejected.why: The lack of family history and the presence of well-delineated contours on ultrasonography make this less likely

rejected.label: Phyllodes tumor
rejected.why: These tumors are typically larger and more rapidly growing than the lesions described

rejected.label: Papillary carcinoma
rejected.why: This type of cancer often presents with nipple discharge and a more complex ultrasonographic appearance

rejected.label: Tubular carcinoma
rejected.why: This is a type of invasive cancer, which is less likely given the benign appearance on ultrasonography

rejected.label: Fat necrosis
rejected.why: This condition typically occurs after trauma and presents with a more irregular ultrasonographic appearance

rejected.label: Granulomatous mastitis
rejected.why: This condition often presents with skin changes and a more complex ultrasonographic appearance

rejected.label: Sclerosing adenosis
rejected.why: This condition can mimic cancer on ultrasonography but is less likely given the well-delineated contours of the masses

rejected.label: Granulomatous mastitis
rejected.why: The clinical presentation and ultrasonography findings do not support this diagnosis
